question.wording: Was this paid out of a joint checking account both spouses have the same interest in, or out of community funds, with nothing showing one spouse alone paid it?

options.label: Yes — joint account or community funds
No — paid by one spouse from their own funds

default.because: Taken as no unless a preparer says so: Was this paid out of a joint checking account both spouses have the same interest in, or out of community funds, with nothing showing one spouse alone paid it?

citation.wording: Any medical expenses paid out of a joint checking account in which you and your spouse have the same interest are considered to have been paid equally by each of you, unless you can show otherwise.
